conversation.user: I have about 420 sq. ft. of exterior wall area and want 10-inch walls. What volume is that?
conversation.assistant:
For 420 square feet of exterior wall area at a 10-inch thickness, you will need approximately 10 to 11 cubic meters (about 350 to 390 cubic feet) of hempcrete material. Keep in mind these figures are rough planning estimates rather than stamped engineering specifications. 

Are you leaning toward using pre-cast blocks or casting the material on-site for this project?

conversation.user: Correction: I remeasured. It's 510 sq. ft., still 10 inches.
conversation.assistant:
With 510 square feet of exterior wall area at a 10-inch thickness, you will need approximately 12 to 13 cubic meters (around 420 to 460 cubic feet) of hempcrete material. Remember that these numbers are helpful planning estimates, not final engineering documents or permit packages.
